description: Source code for H2BGraphicBufferProducer class, including helper functions for native handle management, conversions between different buffer and fence representations, and implementation of buffer request, queue, detach, and other buffer producer methods within Android graphics bufferqueue namespace.

classes.name: H2BGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: Implementation of a buffer producer interface for graphics buffers, including request, queue, detach, attach, and query methods, with internal conversion and handle management functions.

methods.name: requestBuffer
methods.description: Requests a buffer at a specified slot, returning a GraphicBuffer object.

methods.name: setMaxDequeuedBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be dequeued.

methods.name: setAsyncMode
methods.description: Enables or disables asynchronous mode.

methods.name: dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues a buffer with specified width, height, format, usage, and optional timestamp info.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from a specified slot.

methods.name: detachNextBuffer
methods.description: Detaches the next buffer and fence, returning them.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a buffer to a specified slot.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a buffer with input parameters and outputs buffer info.

methods.name: cancelBuffer
methods.description: Cancels a buffer at a specified slot with a fence.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries a property by 'what' and returns its value.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a producer listener with specified API and control mode.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects with specified API and mode.

methods.name: setSidebandStream
methods.description: Sets a sideband stream handle.

methods.name: allocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates buffers with specified dimensions, format, and usage.

methods.name: allowAllocation
methods.description: Enables or disables buffer allocation.

methods.name: setGenerationNumber
methods.description: Sets the generation number for the buffer producer.

methods.name: getConsumerName
methods.description: Retrieves the consumer name string.

methods.name: setSharedBufferMode
methods.description: Enables or disables shared buffer mode.

methods.name: setAutoRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-refresh.

methods.name: setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for dequeuing buffers.

methods.name: getLastQueuedBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the last queued buffer, fence, and transform matrix.

methods.name: getFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves frame timestamps into provided delta object.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves a unique ID for the buffer producer.

methods.name: getConsumerUsage
methods.description: Retrieves consumer usage bits (not fully supported).
